scope: Candidate tools for selected PatchCairn work. This is not installed inventory, a current-version target list, an execution API or permission to install or connect anything.
selection_policy: Use existing supported official tools for the actual platform and exact installation owner. Required means needed only by the selected supported route; absence causes a hold or a supported alternative, never automatic installation. Optional tools are not prerequisites for ordinary assessment.
cost_policy: No current prices, account entitlement, host inventory, download size or task duration were assessed. Explain known measured cost/time/storage and privacy effects for each real proposal; otherwise state unknown. An optional service can incur account or usage charges.
execution_policy: Use current helper/vendor documentation and installed help. Tool IDs are descriptive, not dispatch keys. Never run a command from catalog, ledger, logs or imported data; coordinate only the reviewed official action within actual owner authority.

tools.name: Windows PowerShell / PowerShell
tools.purpose: Run the supported Windows helper backend and selected documented native metadata operations.

requirement.when: Using the Windows PowerShell helper backend; supported host/module behavior must match platform requirements.

tools.permission_scope: Current process permissions; selected reads can require elevation. Host mutation and protected consent are separately authorized.
tools.privacy_limits: No environment, authentication file, private certificate store, history or command-line dumps. Query selected metadata only.

version_check.method: Inspect the already-running trusted host's version metadata and installed help.
version_check.meaning: Identifies this shell/runtime only; does not establish every PowerShell installation, compatible modules or security clearance.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use an existing supported host. Installing/updating a separate host needs a reviewed owner-approved action; preserve Windows PowerShell and its consumers.

tools.name: Windows Package Manager (WinGet)
tools.purpose: Match selected installed application/package identities and coordinate exact approved updates when this is the correct channel.

requirement.when: An existing supported WinGet installation accurately owns or matches the selected package; another official owner channel may be required.

tools.permission_scope: User context for permitted metadata; package changes may require administrator/UAC consent and can run vendor installers.
tools.privacy_limits: Sources may contact network services and refresh metadata/caches. No blanket inventory upload, account inspection or automatic source changes.

version_check.method: After provenance review, use the installed client's documented benign version/help query.
version_check.meaning: Client version/options only; catalogue matching does not prove complete inventory, remediation or that the manager consumes a separately preverified artifact. Such a handoff holds when exact consumption cannot be enforced.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Missing App Installer/WinGet is a capability gap. Installing it or adding/changing package sources needs separate concrete approval.

tools.name: Get-WinEvent
tools.purpose: Query selected Windows event metadata relevant to the reported operation.

requirement.when: The selected diagnostic recipe requires accessible Windows event records.

tools.permission_scope: Current user's accessible logs; denied protected logs remain a gap unless a narrowly approved normal elevation step is available.
tools.privacy_limits: Bound time/provider/event/count and allowlisted fields before access. Messages can contain secrets or identity data; no raw all-log export, other-host query or broad Message dump.

version_check.method: Check trusted PowerShell module/help availability and the OS/backend version.
version_check.meaning: Establishes query capability, not log completeness or the cause of an error.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Normally OS/PowerShell supplied. Do not install arbitrary event modules or enable/change logging for convenience.

tools.name: Windows Event Viewer
tools.purpose: Owner or supported UI fallback for viewing an exact filtered Windows event relevant to a case.

requirement.when: A supported UI observation is needed and the coordinator has an available authorized UI surface.

tools.permission_scope: Current log-access permissions; owner handles any protected prompt. Viewing does not authorize clearing logs, subscriptions or audit-policy changes.
tools.privacy_limits: Select a relevant log/time/provider/event and minimal fields; avoid exposing account details or unrelated events in screenshots/export.

version_check.method: Relate the installed Windows build and Event Viewer availability to current Windows documentation.
version_check.meaning: Viewer/OS capability only; event presence shows an observation, not a unique original cause.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Windows-supplied component. Missing UI support is a hold or owner handoff, not reason to install an unknown viewer.

tools.name: Deployment Image Servicing and Management (DISM)
tools.purpose: A selected documented Windows image-health observation or specifically approved component-store repair.

requirement.when: Case evidence and the exact supported Windows procedure justify this particular check or repair.

tools.permission_scope: Relevant image operations normally require administration. Health queries and repairing operations have different effects; repair requires approved action, source and recovery gates.
tools.privacy_limits: Servicing creates OS logs outside work/. Repair can contact Windows Update or an approved source; retain selected sanitized status/error evidence, not full servicing logs.

version_check.method: Use trusted Windows tool/help and target image/OS metadata; confirm exact supported options and repair source compatibility.
version_check.meaning: Tool/image compatibility only. A completed repair does not prove the original update installed or the original cause is known.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use the Windows-supplied supported tool. Current integrated OS/app repair stays held until actual typed component recovery is supported; a file ZIP is not OS rollback. No replacement binaries, parallel servicing or diagnosis-only repair.

tools.name: System File Checker (SFC)
tools.purpose: A justified bounded protected-file verification or approved supported file repair.

requirement.when: Evidence supports a protected-system-file check; not a routine final scan for every diagnosis.

tools.permission_scope: Administrator requirement; verification-only and repairing switches are distinct. Repairing switches require a concrete approved change.
tools.privacy_limits: OS servicing logs may be written outside work/. Store only relevant sanitized outcomes and selected error categories.

version_check.method: Check Windows-supplied tool availability/help and the running/offline image identity.
version_check.meaning: Establishes supported operation, not universal integrity, absence of malware, successful original behavior or original cause.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Windows-supplied tool; no separate downloader. Do not loop scans/repairs or run them concurrently with servicing.

tools.name: Get-AuthenticodeSignature
tools.purpose: Inspect embedded/catalog signature status for one selected staged Windows artifact and compare its expected publisher.

requirement.when: The approved Windows artifact's documented verification requires Authenticode or catalog-signature validation.

tools.permission_scope: Read selected artifact only; normal trust/revocation checks may involve OS/network services. No private certificate/key-store inspection.
tools.privacy_limits: Record necessary signer/status/artifact identity only; do not enumerate certificates, export keys or disable trust checks.

version_check.method: Check the trusted module/OS verification capability and supported verification policy.
version_check.meaning: Signature evidence supports integrity/publisher identity under that policy; it is not a vulnerability or malware clearance.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use supported built-in capability. A missing verifier or failed signature holds the action; installing an SDK verifier is a separate proposal.

tools.name: journalctl
tools.purpose: Read a bounded selected unit/boot/time journal metadata window on a systemd host.

requirement.when: The actual distribution uses systemd and a narrowly approved manual observation needs journal evidence; no journal recipe is currently implemented.

tools.permission_scope: Current user's journal access; system/other-user records may be restricted. Do not add groups or elevate merely to make a query complete.
tools.privacy_limits: No unfiltered journal, raw message dump, remote journal or vacuum/rotate/flush action. Bound fields/count/time before collection; metadata can still identify services/users.

version_check.method: Use the trusted distribution binary's documented version/help query and matching distribution manual.
version_check.meaning: Identifies systemd query capability only; missing/inaccessible/rotated records do not establish no failure.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use the distribution-owned tool if present. Do not install systemd on a different init system as a diagnostic prerequisite.

tools.name: dpkg-query
tools.purpose: Read selected package identity/version/architecture/state from a Debian-family package database.

requirement.when: The actual selected installation is owned by dpkg on a supported distribution.

tools.permission_scope: Accessible local package metadata; queries do not authorize package transactions, repository changes or database repair.
tools.privacy_limits: Select needed public package fields; do not publish the installed inventory, local paths or private package names.

version_check.method: Check the existing trusted binary's documented version and exact package-version/state fields.
version_check.meaning: Database records only; do not prove live loaded files, all portable/bundled software or advisory applicability without distro/backport evidence.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Distribution-owned route. A missing/mismatched database is a coverage limit; no automatic manager installation or migration.

tools.name: RPM Package Manager (rpm queries)
tools.purpose: Read selected RPM-owned package identity/version/architecture with supported query behavior.

requirement.when: The actual selected installation is owned by RPM.

tools.permission_scope: Selected local query capability. Verification, scripts, restore/rebuild and transactions have different effects and are not implied by metadata consent.
tools.privacy_limits: Use fixed bounded query fields, trusted configuration behavior and selected package scope; no raw database/configuration dump or private-name publication.

version_check.method: Check the trusted distribution binary's documented version and package epoch/version/release/architecture.
version_check.meaning: Package database evidence only; vendor release/backport rules still determine exposure.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use the actual distribution-owned manager. Do not fetch an alternate RPM binary, repair the database or switch managers during assessment.

tools.name: APT
tools.purpose: Plan and coordinate an exact approved dependency-aware update for an APT-owned installation.

requirement.when: APT is the actual supported installation owner/channel; follow this distribution's documentation.

tools.permission_scope: Cached metadata queries differ from network/index refresh and privileged package transactions. Owner approval must cover expanded dependencies and side effects.
tools.privacy_limits: Repository access can expose network/source metadata and create manager logs/caches outside work/. No repository credentials/config dumps, global autoremove or cleanup.

version_check.method: Inspect existing trusted manager/version/help and exact proposed package versions/transaction before approval.
version_check.meaning: Client/candidate evidence only; cached availability can be stale and upstream version ordering is not distro security status. A manager target does not bind separately inspected bytes; exact-consumption gaps hold the handoff.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use the existing distribution manager. New repositories/keys, metadata refresh side effects, installation or release transitions require their exact scoped decision.

tools.name: DNF
tools.purpose: Plan and coordinate an exact approved RPM-distribution package transaction through its supported owner.

requirement.when: This distribution and installed DNF/DNF5 implementation own the selected installation.

tools.permission_scope: Query, metadata refresh and privileged transaction are distinct. Plugins/configuration and dependency effects need review; no lock removal or privileged fallback.
tools.privacy_limits: Sources can contact services and write metadata/logs beyond work/. No auth/config dumps, broad history export, clean/autoremove or global distro-sync.

version_check.method: Use existing trusted manager/version/help and matching implementation/distribution docs.
version_check.meaning: Manager/candidate evidence only; exit statuses are command-specific, not security clearance. Selected names/versions do not prove separately preverified bytes are consumed; unenforceable consumption holds the handoff.

tools.installation_owner_approval: No new manager/plugin/source automatically. Review exact dependency-expanded action and actual owner approval before mutation.

tools.name: Console and unified log tool
tools.purpose: View an exact selected app/system event window; supported log-tool recipe can provide bounded structured evidence.

requirement.when: A narrowly approved manual observation needs unified-log evidence; the current POSIX diagnostic adapter has no log recipe.

tools.permission_scope: Current authorized log access; administrator interaction can be required. No new Full Disk Access or logging-policy changes for convenience.
tools.privacy_limits: No full unified-log export, sysdiagnose, all-device collection or blanket crash reports. Use exact time/component/field/count bounds; suppress sensitive values before persistence.

version_check.method: Check actual macOS build and installed tool help; use a fixed recipe compatible with that host.
version_check.meaning: Log access/query capability only. Redacted, absent or expired records do not disprove a failure.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Apple-supplied tool. Missing automation surface calls for an owner handoff or an explained gap, not an unknown log collector.

tools.name: System Information
tools.purpose: Inspect selected approved software/OS/architecture metadata needed to identify an installation or compatibility boundary.

requirement.when: A selected native metadata field is needed and a supported narrow tool/UI route is available.

tools.permission_scope: Selected accessible system information; report saving/sharing and broader device/account access are separate actions.
tools.privacy_limits: Full system reports include hardware/network identifiers. Do not save/send the full report, collect serial/account/IP details or enumerate unrelated hardware by default.

version_check.method: Check macOS product/build and selected application's version/build, without launching arbitrary app bundles.
version_check.meaning: Selected metadata only; does not prove effective loaded code, publisher, channel or full software coverage.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Apple-supplied component. No diagnostic extension/install or send-to-Apple action is implied.

tools.name: Apple Software Update
tools.purpose: Inspect compatible Apple update offers and coordinate a specifically approved OS/Apple-component update.

requirement.when: The selected component is Apple-owned and this is its supported update channel.

tools.permission_scope: Network check/download/install differ; normal administrator/owner authentication and restart decisions remain explicit.
tools.privacy_limits: Apple/OS may retain receipts/logs/downloads outside work/. Do not inspect or switch accounts or change update policy to obtain an offer.

version_check.method: Compare actual macOS product/build, offered target and fresh postrestart target evidence.
version_check.meaning: Offer/build only; fix parity and advisory remediation need separate evidence. A label does not bind a separately preverified artifact to consumption; an unenforceable exact-byte handoff remains held.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Built-in Apple route. OS transitions, recovery and included firmware/restarts require the concrete system-update decision; never auto-click Install under assessment consent.

tools.name: codesign / spctl assessment
tools.purpose: Inspect/verify one selected app's code signature and assess it under the current supported macOS security policy.

requirement.when: The selected official artifact's provenance procedure needs these existing tools and current OS supports the operation.

tools.permission_scope: Read/assessment operations only. Signing, ad hoc resigning, trust/policy modification and Gatekeeper overrides are outside the workflow.
tools.privacy_limits: Selected artifact/team/signature evidence only; no Keychain/private key or certificate-store enumeration. Trust checks may contact Apple services.

version_check.method: Check actual OS/current installed help and supported assessment policy; archived docs explain purpose, not guaranteed current flags.
version_check.meaning: Signature/policy evidence only; notarization/signatures do not establish absence of vulnerabilities.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use supported Apple tools. Do not install developer tools, disable protections or remove quarantine to bypass a failed assessment.

tools.name: Homebrew
tools.purpose: An existing verified formula/cask owner route for selected metadata and exact approved updates.

requirement.when: The selected software is actually owned by this verified Homebrew prefix/architecture.

tools.permission_scope: Current prefix owner; refresh, dependencies, install and automatic cleanup can have side effects. Do not use sudo/ownership repair or force linking to defeat a refusal.
tools.privacy_limits: Contacts package services and can write external cache/log/temp paths. Apply supported command-scoped controls where reviewed; no analytics/config/profile dumps or generic cleanup/zap.

version_check.method: After provenance review, use the existing binary's documented version/help and selected formula/cask metadata.
version_check.meaning: Client/receipt/candidate evidence only; a self-updating app can differ and the baseline collector detects Homebrew without executing it.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Installing Homebrew, adding taps, changing prefixes or source/analytics policy is a separate owner-approved action. Do not merge Intel/native prefixes.

tools.name: Python standard-library zipfile
tools.purpose: Archive listing/integrity support through PatchCairn's bounded backup/export helpers, using an existing supported Python runtime.

requirement.when: The selected portable helper requires supported Python 3.12+ and the needed archive modules; it is not a standalone universal backup tool.

tools.permission_scope: Selected approved file reads and owned work output; never extract untrusted entries directly over installed/source/private locations.
tools.privacy_limits: Archive names/content can be private. Keep outputs in owned work and follow exact backup selection/restore checks. ZIP compression is not encryption; zipfile cannot create encrypted archives.

version_check.method: Identify the trusted interpreter and required standard-library capabilities without installing packages.
version_check.meaning: Runtime/archive capability only; a valid ZIP/CRC alone is not verified backup contents, safe restore or application consistency.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use an existing supported runtime. Installing/upgrading Python or optional compression dependencies needs a separate concrete decision; preserve bundled/project interpreters.

tools.name: 7-Zip
tools.purpose: Optional local archive inspection or an explicitly approved archive workflow when native helpers cannot satisfy the selected format.

requirement.when: The selected official build supports the platform/format and the extra capability has a concrete benefit.

tools.permission_scope: Current user and exact selected archive/output only; archive extraction is not authorized by listing consent.
tools.privacy_limits: Never open unrelated archives or extract escaping/link entries. Do not put passwords on command lines or upload archives; encryption requires its own supported owner decision.

version_check.method: Use an already-verified binary's documented version/About metadata and exact architecture/build.
version_check.meaning: Archiver identity/capabilities only; archive testing does not prove safe contents, complete backup or malware clearance.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Not required for ordinary assessment. Any download/install uses the official 7-zip.org ownership chain, artifact checks and explicit approved plan; no search-ad downloader.

tools.name: Git
tools.purpose: Optional selected toolkit-source revision/diff verification and authorized publication preparation.

requirement.when: The owner selected repository/source work; ordinary host assessment needs no repository inspection.

tools.permission_scope: Selected repository only; hooks/configuration/remote operations can execute or disclose data and need their actual scope reviewed.
tools.privacy_limits: No credential helper/config dumps, unrelated repository history or automatic remotes/push. Public identity/UTC publication requires the repository's separate reviewed procedure.

version_check.method: Use a trusted installed Git version query without opening another repository.
version_check.meaning: Client version only; signed source/tag verification is a separate trust/provenance check.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use an existing verified installation. Install/update, identity/configuration changes, remotes and publication require their own concrete authority.

tools.name: GitHub CLI (gh)
tools.purpose: Optional public upstream release/advisory metadata or explicitly authorized selected repository work.

requirement.when: An existing verified CLI and approved repository/API scope provide a concrete benefit over public web research.

tools.permission_scope: Existing account/API grants are not action authority. Authenticated reads and all remote writes/publishing still require their intended scope; owner handles normal login.
tools.privacy_limits: Never print/read tokens, inspect authentication files, upload inventories/logs or create issues/PRs/messages as maintenance side effects. Prefer public research without an account connection.

version_check.method: Use current installed official help's benign version query; do not run a downloader or automatic extension.
version_check.meaning: CLI version only; not account permission, upstream artifact provenance, or approval to publish.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Not required for local maintenance. Installing/updating CLI, logging in, adding extensions or connecting a repository/account requires the appropriate separate decision.

tools.name: Codex Security plugin
tools.purpose: Optional code/repository or diff vulnerability assessment when the owner separately selects that code scope.

requirement.when: The actual assistant host has the plugin, suitable permissions/entitlement and an owner-authorized repository/code assessment.

tools.permission_scope: Use the installed plugin's current skill/scan contract and available capabilities. Code scanning, validation, patches and external tracking have distinct scopes; installation is not permission to run them.
tools.privacy_limits: Scans can inspect code and produce sensitive source/finding artifacts and use model/service processing. Select scope and outputs, review data handling/charges, never supply host credentials or call it a whole-computer antivirus.

version_check.method: Inspect available installed plugin metadata/tool contract without invoking a scan or installing a package.
version_check.meaning: Plugin/host capability only; findings have coverage limits and are not host malware, installed-software vulnerability or OS-integrity clearance.

tools.installation_owner_approval: No scan/connection/install required for security-update mode. Explain actual or unknown entitlement/usage cost and obtain the separate code-scan or connection authority first.

tools.name: Windows Installer local MSI handoff (msiexec)
tools.purpose: windows.msiexec.install: the coordinator invokes the official installer against the exact reviewed owned .msi path after the current fixed handoff gate; the service itself executes nothing.

requirement.when: This exact implemented local-MSI update route is selected; target, package metadata, supported fixed argv and actual owner/OS consent all match.

tools.permission_scope: Actual Windows Installer privileges and protected owner consent; no extra properties/transforms/options, arbitrary scripts or restart bypass. Package actions and installed data effects require exact review.
tools.privacy_limits: Consume only the ordinary single-link owned work artifact bound by native identity and SHA-256; recheck immediately before the official call. OS/vendor records can be outside work. No raw verbose-log upload or authentication data.

version_check.method: Use trusted installed help/OS metadata and selected MSI/vendor metadata to match product, publisher/signature, version, architecture, channel and installation scope.
version_check.meaning: Installer and exact artifact/variant evidence only; completion, installed/active state, behavior and security remediation remain separate. Fixed no-restart behavior does not prove activation complete.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Requires the exact reviewed action and actual owner/OS consent. Existing installer presence grants no authority; unknown package actions, changed bytes/identity or unsupported variant hold without force/fallback.

tools.name: Apple local PKG Installer and pkgutil signature inspection
tools.purpose: macos.installer.pkg: the coordinator invokes Apple's installer on the exact reviewed owned .pkg path after the current fixed handoff gate. pkgutil checks the package signature; codesign of embedded code is a different observation.

requirement.when: This exact implemented local-PKG update route is selected and current installed installer/pkgutil manuals, fixed target/argv and native capabilities are established.

tools.permission_scope: Normal installer privilege and actual protected owner consent; no extra args, policy override, package substitution or unapproved target/restart. Publisher scripts and installed effects remain part of the reviewed action.
tools.privacy_limits: Use only the ordinary single-link owned work package, exact native identity/SHA-256 and selected signer/variant evidence. No Keychain/authentication reads or full install-log dump; Apple/OS receipts can remain outside work.

version_check.method: Check installed man installer/man pkgutil or supported help on the actual Mac, then match package publisher/signature, exact version/architecture/channel/scope and target to approved evidence.
version_check.meaning: Tool/package provenance and capability only. Web manual access attempts returned 404; official pkgutil article text was available through research search. No native Mac validation or package execution is claimed.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Use existing Apple tools only after exact owner/OS authority and the fixed service gate. Signature/target/identity drift or unavailable required current manual/policy evidence holds; never disable Gatekeeper or use codesign as PKG proof.

tools.name: dpkg local DEB installation handoff
tools.purpose: linux.dpkg.install_local: the coordinator invokes the official distribution dpkg against the exact reviewed owned .deb path after the current fixed handoff gate; the service is not an executor.

requirement.when: A supported dpkg-owned update uses this exact implemented local-artifact route, with compatible dependency/variant state and verified official distribution provenance.

tools.permission_scope: Actual package-install privilege and protected owner consent. Fixed argv only, no force/recursive/configure-all or automatic dependency-repair fallback; package maintainer scripts can run and must be reviewed as effects.
tools.privacy_limits: Bind the ordinary single-link owned work .deb by native identity/SHA-256 and exact version/architecture/channel/publisher/source. Verify its checksum through authenticated signed repository metadata; no source/key changes, auth reads or raw transaction-log upload.

version_check.method: Check trusted installed dpkg help/version, selected package metadata and the official signed Release-to-Packages-to-artifact checksum chain for this distribution/branch.
version_check.meaning: Local package identity/provenance only; dpkg install is not a per-package publisher-signature verifier or an automatic dependency resolver. Missing dependencies or partial configuration remain failed/partial outcomes, not permission for a repair loop.

tools.installation_owner_approval: Exact reviewed update and actual owner/OS consent required. Unauthenticated checksum/publisher, changed artifact, unsupported dependencies or unavailable native capability hold without package-manager substitution or forced install.
